Name: Male Radio DJ
Dialog: This is Stanky Dog comin' to you on the hottest day of the summer! Unless you live at the beach, I say take it easy and do nothin' today. Yup, just find yourself a shady tree, and maybe an aquatic mammal of some sort, and blow the whole day off.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Come on, Ferb. If we let a little heat stop us from having the best day ever, then the morning DJs win.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Moments later…) Ooh, boy, it's hot today! So what are you up to?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're making our own beach, right here in the backyard.

Name: Linda
Dialog: (Oblivious) Oh, how cute. Well, I'm off for my spa day. You boys behave yourselves and don't bother your father. He's finally cleaning out the basement. (Leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye, Mom! Yes! You heard her. We can't bug Dad which makes me in charge… by default. (pauses) Carry on.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're gonna need more sand. Hey, where's Perry?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Good morning, Agent P. Lawn gnomes across the Tri-State Area are disappearing, leaving thousands of gardens unprotected from the evils of black magic. We suspect Doofenshmirtz. Get right on it.

Name: Contractor
Dialog: Aren't you a little young to be a landscape contractor?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Yes, yes I am.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (dreamy look and voice) Hi, Phineas. (Walks up to him)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, hey Isabella.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What'cha doin'?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Building a beach. Check it out. (Ferb is shown posing on a giant sprinkler.)

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Can me and the other Fireside Girls be lifeguards? We need to earn our Aquatic-Safety badges.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Sure.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Inside…; sitting in the chair, talking to Stacy on her video phone) I mean, I've been a friend of Suzy's longer than Katie, so I should've been invited to that party first. ...I don't care if they're lab partners! We're locker neighbors. And locker neighbors trumps lab partners any day. (Gasps) Sorry, Stacy. Gotta go.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Outside) Welcome to our beach.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hah! You call that a beach? This is WAY below your usual standard. This isn't even worth a call to Mom. You know, if you guys ever want to be popular, you're gonna have to stop playing in sandboxes. (Gets hit by a beach ball) Hey!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: So Candace, what do you think?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it! I'm calling Mom. (dials the phone)

Name: Stacy
Dialog: (arriving with Jenny) Hey, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jenny? Stacy?

Name: Jenny
Dialog: You never told us you had a beach in your backyard!

Name: Stacy
Dialog: You're going to be the most popular girl in the neighborhood.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I will?

Name: Stacy
Dialog: I just saw Jeremy and his buddies with their surfboards.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy's here? (Panting, drops phone) Gotta go! (Zips off)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (chuckles) Yes, yes! Just look at my bounty of gnome riches! Oh, this is a strange one. (The lawn gnome punches Doof in the face) Wait, who are you? (Perry takes off his fake beard and gnome hat) ... A platypus? ... (Perry puts on his fedora) PERRY THE PLATYPUS?! You are mine now! (Presses button, the garage door opens) Oh no, wait, wait, wait. That was the garage door opener. You are mine now! (Presses button, large monitor activates) And that was the TV remote. I've got to start labeling these things. Aha! You are mine now! (Presses button, the cage falls on top of Perry, laughs maniacally) Finally, I will rid myself of you! (brings out another control) But first, turn your attention to the giant screen and… (the garage door closes) Hmm, maybe I need to turn the cable on first?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Let's get this beach party started!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, look! I can see our house from up here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh! (She falls on a crab)

Name: Crowd
Dialog: How low can you go? How low can you go?

Name: Dancer
Dialog: (The crab with Candace on it walks under the limbo, attracting the spectators) Look! So that's how low you can go. We've been asking that question for generations!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? What's everybody looking at?

Name: Dancer
Dialog: For winning the limbo contest, you are now officially crowned Queen Wahini of the beach! (The crowd puts a robe with a Tiki hat on Candace; Song

Name: Candace
Dialog: (overjoyed) I can't believe it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I've never been happier in my entire life!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Something is very wrong. Not a single call from Candace. (Checks her phone) Not even a text message. Oga, hose me down. I'm going home.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, I think I finally got the right one. Now, Perry the Platypus, (Shines flashlight on him) you will finally understand… my PAIN! (presses remote; Flashback) Back in Gimmelshtump in the days of my youth, the Doofenshmirtzes were a proud family. But those were lean times for my father and our beloved lawn gnome was repossessed. Who would protect our zatzenfruit garden from witches, spells, and wood trolls? From a tender age, my father decided that it would be me.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewege dich nicht! ("Don't move!")

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: While the other children played Kick-the-Schtumpel and eat Doonkelberries, I would stand for hours.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewege dich nicht!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: All through the cold night as the Spitzenhounds howled, my only companion was the moon. And my neighbor Kenny.

Name: Mr. Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Bewege dich nicht!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: And since my lawn gnome was taken away from me, I will destroy every lawn gnome in the entire Tri-State Area! Behold, the Destruct-inator! (He pulls a curtain, revealing the giant machine) And now, Perry the Platypus, to activate my creation! (pushes a button and opens Perry's trap) Noooo! (Perry hits him)

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Surf contest!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Out of my way, Dinner-bell.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello, Buford. Perhaps you missed the sign.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (reads the sign) "No Bullying, No Yodeling"?

Name: Man
Dialog: (Austrian accent) I don't like this any more than you do.

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: First up in the surf contest is Bobby Nelson. Oh! And Nelson eats it on the five-footer! And there's Django Brown shooting the curl, and here comes Buford Van Stomm! Ohh! He pummels Brown with a Philadelphia traffic stomp! And now he's got him in a Half-Nelson, now a Full-Nelson, oh! And now he's actually beating him with Bobby Nelson! Here's the scores from our judges. (The scores show 1, 0, and 1/8.) And Buford doesn't like it one bit. (Buford throws Bobby at the table, smashing it.) Next up is Phineas Flynn, and it's great to see a young surfer show such confidence. Uh-oh, what's this? (Buford splashes through the holographic Phineas) Oh, those kids today and their holographic projections. He's in the pipeline, now he's hangin' ten! He's hanging twenty! He's hangin' thirty-two! Now he's just hangin'! The crowd loves it! I don't think there's a name for that! The crowd is doing the wave, and Phineas is surfing it! Let's go to the judges. 10 to the 5th power, infinity, and oh! It seems Phineas Flynn's radical surfing has made judge #3 re-think Einstein's theory of relativity! Cowabunga, laws of nature!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, are you having fun?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Eee... (Cell phone rings) just one second. [the following phone conversation is between Candace at the Beach and the shocked Linda in the car.] (dreamily, on phone) Hellooooo?

Name: Linda
Dialog: Uh, Candace? Is everything okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ohh, everything is just wonderful...

Name: Linda
Dialog: And... Phineas and Ferb? What are they doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (As Phineas surfs in the background) Ohh, such wonderful things...

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, I'm coming home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Needle scratch) Wait, WHAT?

Name: Linda
Dialog: (On phone) I'm right around the corner; I'll be there in two minutes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! No mom, you can't! (Linda turns off the phone.) Oh, wait, wait! Uhh... (at Jeremy) Stay right there! (runs off) I've got to stop her! (Looks out the backyard gate) Oh, no, no, no, no... (Linda arrives) Mom, Mom, pleeaaasee, Mom! Go away! Don't come in!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Is that a volcano?

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Gnooooomes!!! (Gnome hits him) Oof!

Name: Man
Dialog: Run for your lives!! (People run away screaming as gnome continue raining down) It's gnome-ageddon!!!

Name: Man #2
Dialog: Who's protecting our gardens?!!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, tell me the truth. What is going on here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs, talking fast) Phineas and Ferb built a beach in the backyard, just like they said they were going to. But instead of just a cute little beach in their sandbox; it turned out to be this absolutely huge beach, with a coastline, and palm trees, and a pier, and hula dancers, and water skiers, and tiki huts, and dolphins, and dancing, and surfing, and everybody from the neighborhood showed up—

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oof! (The volcano starts sucking down all of the water, splashing down on Perry and Doof.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: …and then I was just about to share a smoothie with Jeremy when a coconut dropped on my head, and

Name: Candace
Dialog: …and just for a moment, it seemed that the wily Buford would steal away the coveted surfing trophy from under the noses of our heroes…

Name: Candace
Dialog: then I can only continue my benign reign and spread love, happiness and ultimate popularity throughout my kingdom! If you would just let me have my moment!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Oh, there you are Perry. (Perry chatters) Well everybody, looks like that's all for today!

Name: Crowd
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb! (X3) (The gate lifts and and closes)

Name: Candace
Dialog: If you don't believe me, go see for yourself. (Linda enters the backyard)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That was great.

Name: Linda
Dialog: Hey, boys.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, mom.

Name: Linda
Dialog: So how was your day at the beach?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, wait, my kingdom… my Jeremy… it was all so beautiful…! (panics, at Phineas and Ferb) What have you done to my paradise?! (pants)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, honey, I think it's time to get you out of the sun for a little while. (she and Isabella lead Candace away.)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (Song

Name: Stanky Dog
Dialog: Stanky Dog here with a special shout-out to my two new pals, Phineas and Ferb, for hosting a beach party that was hot, hot, hot. And speaking of hot, slather on the sunscreen listeners, cause tomorrow's weather calls for another scorcher.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: With a slight chance of scattered lawn gnomes. (Phineas laughs.)
